run_facial_landmark_evaluation: run the eval script to predict facial landmarks on a single image using a trained model
evaluate_single_image: evaluate a single image by passing image path, model snapshot, and face bounding box coordinates
save_visualized_landmarks: save visualized facial landmark predictions as an image file with drawn points and bounding box
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that loads a model, processes an image, and outputs facial landmark coordinates
refactor_eval_transform_pipeline: refactor the eval transform pipeline to support custom preprocessing steps for facial landmark detection
